biggest_catch: This is NOT cash — the 'bonus' is non-withdrawable trading credit you can never take out; only trading profits can be withdrawn, and any withdrawal cuts the bonus proportionally. You must deposit and risk your own real money trading forex/CFDs at up to 500:1 leverage — a $50 deposit gets $75 of margin credit, not $75 cash. Most retail CFD traders lose money; treat this as a leveraged-trading trap, not extra income.
catches: The credit bonus cannot be withdrawn — ever. Only profits generated from trading may be withdrawn under the standard withdrawal process.
Withdrawals and internal transfers result in a proportional or full credit bonus deduction — the landing page's 'Withdraw Anytime' headline is contradicted by its own terms.
You must trade forex/CFDs at up to 500:1 leverage to extract any value — a small market move against you wipes out your deposited funds fast.
Opt-in via the Client Portal or Vantage App is mandatory BEFORE depositing; the bonus is not applied automatically. Proof of Face (identity verification) is required.
Eligible account types only: STP, ECN, Cent, Swap Free, Perpetual, or Copy Trading — Standard and PAMM/MAM accounts are not eligible.
Deposits via e-wallets or digital coins (USDT, Neteller, Skrill) may disqualify the bonus — bank transfer or card preferred.
The promotion mechanism varies by country of residency — only residents of Eligible Countries/Regions qualify; confirm your country's eligibility before pursuing.
Catalog label warning: the route is named 'Vantage/Cash Management' — this is a leveraged forex/CFD trading product, NOT a cash-management account. The route should be recategorized.
